verdict.rationale: Khoj documents official surfaces beyond a single chat window: a web browser interface and a desktop app that syncs your files and folders for contextual search and chat. It also has Obsidian and Emacs clients with search and similar-note discovery, and a WhatsApp client with slash commands such as /online. However, no evidence shows a native mobile app or that features like automations, agents, voice and code execution work equally across these surfaces. missing for 10: a documented native mobile app, explicit feature-parity evidence across web/desktop/mobile, independent hands-on corroboration of the app experiences.
